name: pounce
description: Read and manage Targetprocess cards by name, with your team's rules applied and every write verified.
long_description: pounce lets AI assistants read and manage your cards through the [Targetprocess](https://www.ibm.com/products/targetprocess) REST API. Generic tools are driven by your instance's own API metadata, so custom entity types are covered; workflow tools accept names instead of ids ("move #36400 to Coded", "assign Foxxo as Developer") and apply the team's rules: effort is booked per role, default assignees are cleared on creation, and side effects on parent cards are reported.

base_url.title: Targetprocess URL
base_url.description: Your instance, e.g. https://yourcompany.tpondemand.com (https only, except localhost)

default_project_id.title: Default project id
default_project_id.description: Numeric id of the project for new cards that have no parent to inherit one from

default_team_id.title: Default team id
default_team_id.description: Numeric id of the team for new cards when none is given

toolsets.title: Toolsets
toolsets.description: Tool groups to expose, comma-separated: cards, raw, admin (empty: all three)
